sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 10424 of 2023
Applicant :- Mohd. Majeed And Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.

And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Rakesh Kumar Nayak Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Shri Aniruddh Kumar Singh, the learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the material placed on record.

Instant application has been filed with the prayer to quash the summoning order dated 23.6.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate, Room No.23, Sultanpur in Complaint Case No.3315 of 2023 (Raziya Bano Vs. Mohd. Aaslam & others) by means of which the Judicial Magistrate has summoned the applicants for offence under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. read with Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act as well as revisional order dated 29.8.2023 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge,
Room No.4, Sultanpur by means of revision of the applicants has been rejected by the same.

entities.text: Complaint Case No.3315 of 2023 (Raziya Bano Vs. Mohd. Aaslam & others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the applicants submits that this is purely a dispute civil in nature as there is a matrimonial dispute between the husband and the wife and due to which the instant FIR has been lodged and criminal proceedings have been initiated against the applicants and it is harassment of the family members including the husband.
He further added that there is all possibility of compromise between the parties and this matter may be referred to Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Learned A.G.A. appearing for the State has no objection to the contentions aforesaid.

The matter is remitted to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this court and it is directed that applicants shall deposit a sum of Rs.15,000/- within two weeks from today with the Mediation Centre of this Court out of which Rs.10,000/- shall be paid to the opposite party no.2, on the date fixed, for her first appearance before the Mediation Centre and Rs.5,000/- shall be retained by the Mediation Centre as mediation fee.

After deposit of such amount by the applicants, it shall issue notice to the parties fixing some date for mediation and shall make all possible efforts to conclude the mediation and conciliation proceedings expeditiously, preferably within a period of three months.
List after expiry of aforesaid period before the appropriate Bench along with the report of Mediation Centre.

Till the next date of listing, further proceedings ofComplaint Case No.3315 of 2023 (Raziya Bano Vs.
Mohd. Aaslam & others) shall remain stayed so far as the applicant is concerned.
